text.en: Raju plotted three points on his graph sheet. "Do they make a triangle or lie on one line?" he wondered.

The area of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3) is half the absolute value of x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2). If this area is zero, the three points are collinear. The area of a quadrilateral is found by splitting it into two triangles.
A line’s inclination is measured from the positive x-axis. If the line is non-vertical, its slope is the tangent of its inclination, or change in y divided by change in x. Parallel non-vertical lines have equal slopes. Perpendicular lines with defined slopes have a product of −1. A vertical and a horizontal line form a right angle too.
The equation of a straight line has several forms: slope-intercept y = mx + c, point-slope, two-point, intercept form x/a + y/b = 1 and the general form ax + by + c = 0. The equations of the coordinate axes are y = 0 and x = 0.
The area of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2), (x3, y3) is half the absolute value of x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2).
If this area is zero, the three points are collinear.
The area of a quadrilateral is found by splitting it into two triangles.
A line’s inclination is measured from the positive x-axis. For a non-vertical line, the slope is the tangent of its inclination, or the change in y divided by the change in x.
Parallel non-vertical lines have equal slopes. Perpendicular lines with defined slopes have a slope product of minus one. A horizontal line and a vertical line are perpendicular too.
The equation of a straight line has several forms: slope-intercept y = mx + c, point-slope, two-point, intercept form x/a + y/b = 1 and the general form ax + by + c = 0.
The equations of the coordinate axes are y = 0 and x = 0.
To plot negative two comma three, move two units left and three units up from the origin. Reading the coordinates in the other order gives a different point.

text.en: Between points one comma two and four comma six, the horizontal and vertical changes are three and four. Pythagoras gives a distance of five units.

text.en: The midpoint of one comma two and five comma six is three comma four. Average the two x values and then the two y values.

text.en: Start at one comma one and travel one third of the way to seven comma four. Add one third of each coordinate change to get three comma two.

text.en: Write each vertex once. Multiply and subtract as in the coordinate area formula. Take the absolute value at the end so the area is positive.

board.text: Area: use three vertices in order

text.en: A triangle with vertices one comma one, five comma one, and one comma four has horizontal base four and vertical height three. Its area is six square units.
The points zero comma zero, one comma two, and two comma four follow the same line. Their coordinate area is zero.

board.text: Zero area identifies a straight line

text.en: Label the four vertices in order. Split the shape into two triangles along a diagonal inside it. Find and add their areas.

board.text: Use an internal diagonal in a quadrilateral

text.en: Coordinate changes measure distance in units. Because area multiplies lengths, the result is expressed in square units.

board.text: Area is read in square units

text.en: From one comma two to three comma six, the rise is four and the run is two. The slope is two.
If you start at three comma six, the rise is negative four and the run is negative two. Dividing them still gives positive two.

board.text: Reverse both changes and keep the same ratio

text.en: If x increases by two while y decreases by three, the slope is minus three halves.

board.text: Down to the right gives a negative slope

text.en: A horizontal line has zero rise. A vertical line has zero run, and dividing by zero does not give a slope.

board.text: Horizontal slope zero; vertical slope undefined

text.en: Two non-vertical lines with equal slopes and different intercepts are parallel. With the same intercept as well, they are the same line.
A slope of two is perpendicular to a slope of minus one half. Their product is minus one.

board.text: Perpendicular slope is a negative reciprocal

text.en: For y equals two x plus three, the slope is two and the line passes through zero comma three.

board.text: y = mx + c shows the y-intercept

text.en: If the slope is three and the line contains two comma five, write y minus five equals three times x minus two, with x minus two in brackets.
For two points on a non-vertical line, calculate the slope first and then use either point in the point-slope form.

board.text: Two points let you get a slope and an equation

text.en: When the nonzero intercepts are four and two, write x divided by four plus y divided by two equals one. Test each intercept by setting the other coordinate to zero.
For two x plus three y minus six equals zero, putting x equals zero gives a y-intercept of two. Putting y equals zero gives an x-intercept of three.
Every point on x equals four has first coordinate four. Its second coordinate can vary.
Substitute both coordinates into the equation. The point two comma five lies on y equals two x plus one because five equals two times two plus one.
To draw a line, mark two known points and join them. Use another substitution to check that the line is heading in the correct direction.

problem.en: Find the slope of the line through (1, 2) and (3, 6).

text.en: The slope is 2.

problem.en: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (1, 1), (5, 1), and (1, 4).

text.en: Use (1, 1) to (5, 1) as a horizontal base of length 4.

why.en: Subtract the x-coordinates along that side.

text.en: The perpendicular height is 4 − 1 = 3. Area = ½ × 4 × 3 = 6 square units.

why.en: A horizontal base has a vertical height.
Use the same order for the two coordinate differences.

text.en: Write y − 2 = 2(x − 1), so y = 2x. Check both given points.

why.en: Substituting x = 1 gives 2, and x = 3 gives 6.

text.en: Let y = 0. This gives 2x = 6, so the x-intercept is (3, 0).

why.en: Each point on the x-axis has y = 0.

text.en: Let x = 0. This gives 3y = 6, so the y-intercept is (0, 2).

why.en: Each point on the y-axis has x = 0.
